name: MegaFon
note: Zenit and Krylia Sovetov partner. Shorts sponsor of HC Metallurg Magnitogorsk (МЕГАФОН on the 2026/27 game shorts): logo visible on the season kit render and a 2026-09-06 match photo via the KHL.Marketing kits article on sports.ru; Megafon's own press release of 2026-02-26 confirms the continuing club partnership. FC Rostov premium sponsor per the club's sponsors page (checked 2026-10-03); no shirt placement confirmed on Rostov's 2026-27 home kit. Wholly owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Holding (claim megafon-usm-ownership); MegaFon's 2022 annual report states the state does not participate in the company's charter capital, and Kommersant (June 2025) confirms the same two USM LLCs hold the shares 50/50. A 'none' tier was proposed in earlier PRs but not set: USM's own shareholder composition is not documented in the sources opened, so the record stays unrated.
